map.在帧数与秒数之间互转：已知帧数求时长，或已知时长求总帧数。: Convert between frame count and seconds: given a frame count find the duration, or given a duration find the total frames.
map.在常见视频帧率（24/25/30/60fps）间换算并估算时长变化，用于剪辑与格: Convert between common video frame rates (24/25/30/60fps) and estimate the duration change, for editing and format conversion reference; the front-end conversion does not transcode.
map.多因帧率取值不同（如 29.97 与 30 混用）；请确认源素材真实帧率，长素材: Most often because the frame rate value differs (such as mixing 29.97 with 30); confirm the true frame rate of the source, because over long material a 0.1% difference accumulates into a clear duration deviation.
map.帧数需要取整吗？: Do frame counts need to be integers?
map.换算结果与播放器显示不一致？: The conversion does not match the player display?
map.校核动画/延时摄影的分镜长度，确认按目标帧率渲染后的成片秒数。: Check the shot length of an animation or time-lapse to confirm the final seconds after rendering at the target frame rate.
map.核对剪辑时间线与素材帧数是否匹配，避免导出后时长对不上。: Check that the edit timeline matches the frame count of the material so the exported duration is right.
map.物理帧数只能是整数，工具按四舍五入取整；但时长计算用未取整值更精确，尤其在音频对: A physical frame count can only be an integer and the tool rounds; but keeping the unrounded value is more accurate for duration, especially when aligning audio.

map.：150 帧 @30fps = 150/30 = 5 秒；3 秒 @24fps: : 150 frames at 30fps = 150/30 = 5 seconds; 3 seconds at 24fps = 3x24 = 72 frames. A 240-frame time-lapse played at 24fps gives a 10-second video, while at 12fps it gives 20 seconds.
map.：帧 → 秒：秒数 = 帧数 ÷ 帧率；秒 → 帧：帧数 = 秒数 × 帧率。帧: : frame to seconds: seconds = frames / frame rate; seconds to frames: frames = seconds x frame rate. The frame rate must be greater than 0 or the conversion is impossible; both directions share the frame rate as the bridging quantity.
